CustomField.description: When the guest's post-trip feedback arrived: the latest Feedback_Response__c.Submitted_On__c. Calculated by Salesforce (roll-up), so it fills in the moment the survey is submitted and clears if the response is deleted. With Status__c = Feedback, empty means invited but not answered yet.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Wann das Feedback des Gastes eingegangen ist. Wird automatisch gesetzt, sobald der Gast die Umfrage absendet. Leer bedeutet: noch keine Antwort.
CustomField.label: Feedback erhalten am
